research_question: How well can each sensing modality detect machine anomalies on its own, per machine, under the leakage-controlled Protocol B?
cross_modality_cells: none; all-channel and fusion cells belong to Multi-Sensor Fusion Development

families.input: engineered segment-median features of one modality, train-only z-score
engineered segment-median features of one modality, train-only z-score
engineered segment-median features of one modality, train-only z-score
engineered segment-median features of one modality, train-only z-score
families.implementation: src.models.mahalanobis (phase4-mahalanobis-shrinkage-v1): sklearn.covariance.LedoitWolf, assume_centered=false; score = squared Mahalanobis distance
families.role: closed-form Gaussian density with feature correlation (research definition section 11 row 1)

families.input: per-window log-power spectrum of one modality, train-only per-bin z-score
families.architecture: d -> 256 -> 64 -> 16 -> 64 -> 256 -> d; ReLU hidden; linear output
families.role: learned per-modality reconstruction scorer; the model the fusion stage builds on

modality_inputs.classical_feature_columns: columns of the frozen 98-feature Phase-3.1 artifact whose name starts with '<modality>__' (mic 14, acc 42, gyro 42)
autoencoder_pipeline: frozen resample_regular at the configured target rate

truncate to fixed length floor(0.1 * target_rate) - 2 samples (mic 1598; RoboticArm acc/gyro 704; BrushlessMotor acc/gyro 711); the -1 proposal was falsified by 121 RoboticArm mic windows of 1598 resampled samples measured over all 194,165 train/validation windows before any model was fit; shorter windows are technical defects
concatenate channels of that modality only (channel-major)
modality_inputs.raw_waveform_input: not selected for this benchmark (not claimed invalid)

threshold_policy: empirical q90 of source-validation segment scores, quantile method higher; identical rule for every configuration
seed_aggregation: frozen R8 rule: per bootstrap replicate compute each seed's metric and average; deterministic families carry seed 0 as a ledger field only; no best-seed selection

protected_evaluation.score_all: all 156 looks appended atomically; scoring loop reads no anomaly label and computes no metric; per-segment tables hashed into a sealed staging manifest
protected_evaluation.analyse_once: refuses unless exactly 156 hashed tables verify; then AUROC, AUPRC with prevalence, pAUROC@0.10, source/target slices, healthy-target FPR at frozen q90, seed aggregation, paired modality contrasts, T-minus-S contrasts; a completed analysis is final
protected_evaluation.reporting_conventions: phase3.2.1: count-identity F1, undefined precision when nothing flagged, AP minus prevalence context

pre_registered_contrasts.regime: T minus S within each (machine, modality, family)
pre_registered_contrasts.dominance_rule: a modality dominates another on a machine and regime only when the paired CI excludes zero with the same sign in every one of the five families; otherwise the ranking is reported as model-dependent

pre_registered_expectations: the microphone is the modality whose target-slice ranking metrics and healthy-target false-positive rate degrade most, because the environmental shift is injected into the audio channel only
BrushlessMotor results are benchmark discrimination on the released cohort and are never worded as pure mechanical-fault sensitivity (brushless_motor_acquisition_time_class_confound_v1)
RoboticArm target-slice values rest on 20 healthy segments from 6 parents and are reported with that disclosure
reproduction_check_before_scoring: every bundle's config/provenance/threshold/score files and every model artifact (checkpoint or joblib) are hash-verified against the frozen manifests; the frozen checkpoint is scored, never a retrain
